question: The area (in cm²) of an equilateral triangle whose height is 6 cm, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ 
Area of an **equilateral triangle** in terms of **height (h)** = h² / √3
 
Given height h = 6 cm
 
Area = 6² / √3 = 36 / √3
 
Area = (12 × 3) / √3 = 12√3 cm²
 
**∴ The correct answer is 12√3 cm².**
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
 
**Given:** **Height (h)** of the equilateral triangle = 6 cm
 
**Formula Used:**
 
1. Height of an equilateral triangle (h) = (√3 / 2) × side (a)
 
2. Area of an equilateral triangle = (√3 / 4) × a²
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4173ce9790bdab1950be4b0966c21f2b3d730d6fd0db4226f5623d32c52fb57.png] 
**Calculations:**
 
⇒ 6 = (√3 / 2) × a
 
⇒ a = (6 × 2) / √3
 
⇒ a = 12 / √3 = 4√3 cm
 
⇒ Area = (√3 / 4) × (4√3)²
 
⇒ Area = (√3 / 4) × (16 × 3)
 
⇒ Area = √3 × 4 × 3
 
⇒ Area = 12√3 cm²
 
**∴ The correct answer is 12√3 cm².**
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
 
Equilateral Triangle Properties
 
All three sides are equal and each **interior angle** is exactly 60°.
 
Inradius and Circumradius
 
**Inradius (r)** = a / (2√3) and **Circumradius (R)** = a / √3, where 'a' is the side length.
 
Perimeter
 
The **perimeter** of an equilateral triangle is 3 × side (3a).</p
